method: Authenticated browser review of the visible application; no hidden APIs, submitted financial records, uploaded files or paid actions.
scope: Empty account with an active 14-day Basic trial. Views and unsaved forms were examined. A completed third-party settlement, populated reports, document editing and banking reconciliation could not be tested without a property and source data.

views.observed: Shared property/year context, rent expected/received, cashflow, urgent tasks, billing preparation with individually actionable cost-category suggestions, meter compliance and upcoming deadlines.
views.decision: Keep direct source links and local reports. Use named, optional cost-entry suggestions in billing. Do not present all suggested cost categories as legally mandatory or treat empty reports as proof of correctness.

views.observed: Property, year and status filters, overview totals and a single entry to creation.
views.decision: Added explicit property/year/status filters and direct statement-letter access to ImmoManager's existing overview.

views.observed: Four visible stages: period, costs, allocation, completion. Annual period with an optional custom start/end. Further stages require a property.
views.decision: Keep ImmoManager's existing guarded calculation and correction workflow; make cost editing, validation and result documents directly reachable instead of introducing a second calculator.

views.observed: Recoverable and owner costs are explained separately; DATEV export and batch receipt reading are advertised. New expense requires a property.
views.decision: Retain recoverability and origin references while editing. No claim of a verified DATEV transfer is made. Existing independent tax/export work remains separate.

views.observed: Title, notes, priority, due/reminder date; optional property/unit/tenant association and recurrence. Recurrence choices include daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and yearly with interval/end date.
views.decision: Implemented those readable rhythms plus a custom editor against our real scheduler semantics. Existing rules and unfinished user drafts are preserved.

views.observed: Folders, categories, tags, text/content search and drag/drop upload. Visible upload form names PDF, JPG, PNG and DOCX with a 10-MB limit.
views.decision: Keep our document originals, versions, annotation/editor and party context. Do not introduce the competitor's fixed upload-size policy. Additional folder/tag ideas need a real workflow gap before adding overlapping controls.

views.observed: Separate template hub for rental agreements, house rules, cleaning schedules, waste calendars and privacy information. Unsaved house-rule form has selectable standard sections, custom sections and preview/save/generate actions.
views.decision: The professional letter editor reuses this useful form/preview distinction. A comprehensive house-rules/rotation-plan editor is a separate product extension, not claimed completed by this change. Preserve Claude's ongoing reletting work.

views.observed: Year/property selection, a dated preliminary-result indication, cashflow and settlement balance separated; income, expenses, financing, settlements and surplus tabs. Print outputs are differentiated by cost report, income/expenses and rent payments.
views.decision: Retain explicit report bases and drilldowns in our existing local financial reports. Empty external results do not validate our calculations. Topic-specific report printing remains a candidate where no equivalent exists.

views.observed: Preparation, PDF review and delivery are presented as separate steps, with a distinct outgoing-mail overview.
views.decision: New billing letters become verified archived documents and use existing communication paths. Recording a delivery asks for the actual channel and does not itself send anything.

implemented_in_this_change: Concise branding and new vector building mark in navigation, login and favicon
Task recurrence presets and safe custom configuration
Property/year/status billing filters, source-cost templates and full edit/delete flow
Calculation breakdown and direct personalized letter/PDF access
Stateless hash-bound preview and immutable correspondence originals
Equal-total line changes invalidate the calculation review
Preserved Claude meter history and tenant detail improvements, with integration and navigation fixes
not_claimed_verified: A fully populated Vermieter1 settlement and its generated final PDF
Paid letter delivery, bank-account connection or AI-credit consumption
WISO target import or TEHA write acceptance

subscription.confirmation_evidence: Recorded separately from source changes after the cancellation UI confirms the outcome.
